user.title: Balter EVO / Quvii Cloud
user.description: Sign in with your Quvii cloud account (the app's e-mail + password, not the local device password). The door PIN is optional and only available under Configure.

reauth_confirm.title: Balter EVO – sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The Balter cloud rejected the stored credentials for {email}. Please enter the password again.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Quvii cloud server

abort.unique_id_mismatch: Those credentials belong to a different account than the configured one

data_description.door_pin: Leave empty to use the unlock code the door station has registered in the cloud. Only set this if you deliberately want to send a different PIN -- a wrong PIN is rejected silently by the station.
data_description.warm_idle: How long the connection to the door station stays open after a command. Within that window another press unlocks instantly instead of paying for the full handshake (5-8 s) plus the station's recovery pause. While the connection stands, the station is busy for the doorbell and the phone app -- so do not set this higher than needed. 0 disables keeping it open.

record_clip.name: Record clip
record_clip.description: Records a short clip from the door station and saves it as MP4.
